consequence.statement: Traefik will fail to start if InfluxDB v1 metrics configuration (metrics.influxDB) is present in the static configuration.

original.statement: The InfluxDB v1 metrics provider configuration has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and will prevent Traefik from starting if present.

decision.reason: [ev-a8010075f3de] says the InfluxDB v1 metrics provider has been removed in v3 and that its configuration "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start". The remediation is to remove that configuration from the static configuration. If the operator leaves it in place, the upgraded Traefik cannot start. That is a hard failure, so the upgrade-blocked kind (mandatory work) and critical severity fit. The proposed statement says the same thing.
